### Install
1. Download **Hum.zip** below, unzip it and move `Hum.app` to Applications.
2. Open it. macOS will block it because Hum isn't notarized yet. Go to **System Settings → Privacy & Security** and click **Open Anyway**, or run:
   ```
   xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Hum.app
   ```
3. When asked, allow Hum to control Spotify or Music.

Requires macOS 14+ on Apple Silicon (every Mac with a notch).
